verification.note: addons/knowledge/frontend/__tests__/Editor.versions.test.tsx:891-895: the it.each rows in the I7 describe (line 837) are b, i, e and k+shift only. addons/knowledge/frontend/Editor.tsx:1138-1143 defines { key: "ctrl+k", label: tShortcuts("insertLink"), handler: () => handleToolbar({ kind: "link" }) }. A Grep for "k"/ctrl+k/Mod-k under addons/knowledge/frontend/__tests__ found only Editor.versions.test.tsx:895 (shift), MarkdownEditor.test.tsx:270 (Shift-Mod-k) and PlainTextEditor.test.tsx:695/697 (the plain-text side, where nothing should happen). A Grep for 'insertLink' finds only Editor.tsx and the message files, so no help-overlay test asserts it. No e2e spec uses Control/Meta+k. The link insertion logic is tested only through the toolbar and the pure helper (EditorToolbar.test.tsx:282, editor.test.ts:149), not through the shortcut. Deleting the ctrl+k entry would therefore fail no test I could find. I did not run the suite.
